simple.summary: אַלְמוֹדָד (ʼAlmôwdâd) means Almodad , a son of Joktan First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 20.

definitions.full: H486. Almodad אַלְמוֺדָד proper name of South-Arabian people (but probably read אֵל (Sabean, god ) for אַל , compare Di Gen 10:26 , & Glas Sk. ii. 280; ii. 425, 435 God is loved (?)) 10:26 ; 1Chr 1:20 .
